$description: Neutrino colour tokens, named as in Nitesh's Figma. Values are resolved per theme; the palette is the source.

white-0.$description: Buttons, inputs, cards, menus, dialogs, the composer. CSS --bg-white-0.

weak-25.$description: Disabled controls; chips, the selected row, stat cards. CSS --bg-weak-25.

weak-50.$description: Quiet fills: soft buttons and their hover, composer controls, the user's bubble. CSS --bg-weak-50.

soft-200.$description: A pressed or picked fill, the user's avatar. CSS --bg-soft-200.

sub-300.$description: Strong neutral fills, a switch that is off. CSS --bg-sub-300.

surface-800.$description: Dark neutral fills: the Neutral filled button. CSS --bg-surface-800.

strong-950.$description: The strongest fill: Neutral filled on hover, tooltips. CSS --bg-strong-950.

page.$description: Main page and the chat thread (dark sits a step under bg/white-0) (Neutrino only). CSS --bg-page.

ground.$description: Sidebar and top bar, under the page (Neutrino only). CSS --bg-ground.

strong-950.$description: Headings, titles, the picked item, words on hover. CSS --text-strong-950.

sub-600.$description: Secondary words, sidebar rows, Neutral buttons at rest. CSS --text-sub-600.

soft-400.$description: Group labels, captions, quiet words. CSS --text-soft-400.

white-0.$description: Words on bg/strong-950 and bg/surface-800. CSS --text-white-0.

body.$description: Chat answers and long reading (Neutrino only). CSS --text-body.

muted.$description: Placeholders, hints, times: between sub and soft (Neutrino only). CSS --text-muted.

white-0.$description: Icons on bg/strong-950 and bg/surface-800. CSS --icon-white-0.

soft-200.$description: Every hairline: dividers, card and button edges, table rules, the search box. CSS --stroke-soft-200.

white-0.$description: An edge in the colour of bg/white-0 (a cut-out ring). CSS --stroke-white-0.

rim.$description: The edge of cards and the composer: a whisper in dark (Neutrino only). CSS --stroke-rim.

white.$description: Words and icons on Primary and on status fills. CSS --static-white.

black.$description: Words and icons that stay dark in both themes. CSS --static-black.

dark.$description: Primary on hover. CSS --primary-dark.

base.$description: The main action: Primary buttons, Send, blue icons, the New chat plus. Lighter on dark, as in the Figma. CSS --primary-base.

light.$description: A light blue fill. CSS --primary-light.

lighter.$description: The lightest blue fill. CSS --primary-lighter.

alpha-10.$description: Soft Primary buttons and their hover, the Primary focus ring. CSS --primary-alpha-10.

text.$description: Links, the tools tray, blue words (Neutrino only). CSS --signal-text.

wash.$description: A faint blue fill behind signal text (Neutrino only). CSS --signal-wash.
